applicant.name: Dr. Felix Haas
applicant.organisation: Institute for Health Services Research, readmission study

purpose: Research on repeated hospital admissions to plan transitional care.
question: How many patients had at least one inpatient stay between 2023 and 2025 and how many of them had two or more, for women and men?
definitions: Inpatient stay = encounter with type 'inpatient'; count stays that started from 1 January 2023 to 31 December 2025.
Report per sex: patients with at least one inpatient stay and patients with two or more inpatient stays.
